Both findings apply to the current Advect checkout (main, clean working tree).

  • Obsolete extension feature: PyO3 is declared as 0.29 in Cargo.toml and locked to 0.29.2, not the screenshot’s 0.29.3, in Cargo.lock. The native crate defines extension-module = ["pyo3/extension-module"] in its manifest, activated in pyproject.toml. Maturin’s floor is already 1.12 (pyproject.toml:79); portable wheels explicitly use 1.14.1 (workflow:97). Assuming the parent’s upstream check confirms the behavior for PyO3 0.29.2, remove that feature block and its Maturin activation. It is the only authored Cargo feature, so Clippy’s --all-features is then redundant.

  • Clippy severity weakening: Cargo.toml:33 sets all = { level = "warn", priority = -1 }. Both crates inherit workspace lints (native, runtime). No correctness override was found. Remove only the all entry, retaining pedantic/nursery and individual policy choices. CI’s -D warnings already makes those warnings errors, so this fixes default local severity rather than a known CI gap.

If implemented, align documented Clippy commands in both scoped AGENTS.md files and testing.md/adding-operations.md. cargo deny --all-features also becomes unnecessary for current workspace features but is harmless and separate from lint correctness.

Verified source/configuration only; no builds or tests run, no changes, commits, pushes, PR mutations, or comments. These are build/lint maintenance findings; nothing inspected establishes a numerical or autodiff defect.

Advect’s two additional findings differ:

3. uv build simplification: applies to its source-distribution job. native-wheels.yml:187 builds the sdist, then explicitly builds a wheel from that archive. These can become:

uv build --package advect --out-dir dist/sdist --clear

Use default behavior; explicitly specifying both --sdist --wheel can have different wheel-source semantics. Parent is checking upstream documentation.

The minimal accompanying adjustments are wheel inspection at line 199 and installation’s --find-links at line 224, both switching to dist/sdist. Preserve archive-content validation, wheel-license validation, and the installed-wheel smoke test. Keep the upload restricted to advect-*.tar.gz (line 232); this smoke wheel should not enter the portable release-wheel set.

Other two-wheel commands in evidence.yml:140 build different reference and candidate revisions and cannot collapse this way. Ordinary documented --wheel builds intentionally skip the sdist.

4. Accidental Hypothesis CI inheritance: does not apply to current Advect. conftest.py:14 obtains settings.get_profile("default") and explicitly passes it as parent for both advect and thorough. Advect does not have the screenshot’s custom dev/ci profile arrangement.

I probed installed and locked Hypothesis 6.148.3 with and without CI=true GITHUB_ACTIONS=true. CI initially selected Hypothesis’s built-in ci, but executing Advect’s configuration produced identical effective profiles in both environments:

Profile Examples Deadline Suppressed health checks Derandomize
advect 100 500 ms None False
thorough 1000 None None False

Both retain the example database and print_blob=False. The main test commands load advect; the conformance job selects --hypothesis-profile=thorough.

Verified configuration and effective profiles, without executing tests or package builds. Clean local main remains at 0e7a74b6; nothing changed or pushed, and no PR state or comments changed.
